title: How Many Martins to BEAT Stockfish?
summary: Community-poll piece: Tony has a king plus N 'Martins' (a piece wearing the Martin bot's face that moves one square in any direction, like a non-royal king) vs Fairy-Stockfish's full army. 1 Martin loses quickly (~1:46); he jumps to 7, then 15, and finally swarms with 31 Martins filling ranks 2-5, forcing Stockfish to give up its queen and mating (~16:03).
rules: Player: king + N Martins; opponent: full standard army.
Martin piece moves/captures one square in any direction (commoner, non-royal).
Add Martins after each loss (video: 1 -> 7 -> 15 -> 31; large jumps rather than +1).

custom_pieces.name: Martin
custom_pieces.look: round piece with the chess.com Martin bot face (bald, smiling, mustache)

setup: White: king + N Martins (final: 31 filling ranks 2-5 around the king). Black: standard army.
current_impl_issues: Impl maps to 'multi' (2 moves vs 1) — wrong. Should be king + N commoner 'Martin' pieces vs full army with escalating counts.
